intro.en: Drag-chain cable is engineered around the complete repeated-motion profile.
intro.zh: 拖链电缆围绕完整重复运动谱进行设计。

knowledge.en: Travel, bend radius, speed, acceleration, carrier layout, construction and environment define service life together.
knowledge.zh: 行程、弯曲半径、速度、加速度、拖链布置、结构与环境共同定义寿命。

notes.en: Provide motion, circuits, carrier, endpoints, environment and cycle target.
notes.zh: 请提供运动、回路、拖链、端点、环境与循环目标。

delivery.en: Release records the complete moving cable system and agreed cycle evidence.
delivery.zh: 放行记录包含完整运动线缆系统与约定循环证据。

subtitle.en: Design the cable, carrier and motion profile as one system
subtitle.zh: 把线缆、拖链与运动谱作为一个系统设计

lead.en: Define repeated flexing before selecting conductor, jacket or shield.
lead.zh: 先定义重复弯曲，再选择导体、护套与屏蔽。
